title: PhageMatch-PK: capsule-type phage coverage analysis for Klebsiella pneumoniae
description:
Analysis code for the study Capsule types driving carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae in Pakistan are largely absent from the phage literature.

Types the capsule (K) loci of 254 Pakistani clinical K. pneumoniae genomes and 475 comparison genomes from India, Bangladesh, Nepal, China, Europe and the USA; curates the published phage and depolymerase literature into a graded phage-capsule evidence table (34 records, 27 phages, 15 capsule types); and identifies capsule types with no published phage. Includes a BioProject-collapsed sensitivity analysis, since outbreak-derived genomes dominate public collections and can present clonal expansion as geographic signal.

No new sequence data were generated. All genomes are public NCBI assemblies.
